23167T1
SUBSTITUTE
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
2328-34 Montana Street
From M1-2 AND RT-4 to RT-4

The Applicant is seeking a map amendment for four vacant parcels at 2328-34W. Montana Street, to
rezone them from their current M1-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and RT-4 Residential
Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, to RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District, to RT-4 to build four build four 3-story, 2-unit brick, residences. Three parcels, at 2328-2832 W.
Montana Street, are currently zoned M1-2. The fourth parcel, at 2834 W. Montana Street, is zoned RT-4
All four buildings will be part of the same development. Applicant is the owner of the subject property.
The buildings will be 38°-tall. Each parcel will include two parking spaces.

The Applicant requires relief for the lots at 2328 and 2334 W. Montana Street. The Applicant is seeking
to (1) reduce the minimum required west side setback from 2’ to 0.50” (east side setback at 4.50°) for a
total combined setback of 5.0’ at 2328 W Montana; and reduce the minimum required east side setback
from 2’ to 0.50” (west side setback at 4.50’) for a total combined setback of 5.00’ at 2334 W Montana.

The Applicant seeks all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the attached
plans.
